hooks.command: command -v jq >/dev/null || { echo 'hook needs jq on PATH' >&2; exit 1; }; f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | tr '\\' '/'); case "$f" in *.rs) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && cargo fmt --quiet 2>&1 && out=$(cargo clippy --quiet -- -D warnings 2>&1) || { printf '%s\n' "$out" | head -20 >&2; exit 2; }

command -v jq >/dev/null || { echo 'hook needs jq on PATH' >&2; exit 1; }; f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | tr '\\' '/'); case "$f" in */Cargo.toml) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && out=$(cargo deny check 2>&1) || { printf '%s\n' "$out" | tail -20 >&2; exit 2; }

command -v jq >/dev/null || { echo 'hook needs jq on PATH' >&2; exit 1; }; f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | tr '\\' '/'); case "$f" in *Documents/Draupnir*) echo 'BLOCK: do not edit the vault directly — this CLI reads the vault, it does not write to it during development' >&2; exit 2;; */Cargo.lock) echo 'BLOCK: never edit Cargo.lock directly — change Cargo.toml and let cargo resolve' >&2; exit 2;; esac; exit 0
